name: shoe

source.prompt: One high-end unbranded everyday athletic sneaker with a chunky white sculpted foam sole and light-gray woven knit upper, subtle leather panels and real lace texture. Horizontal three-quarter side profile, toe faces left. Crisp realistic stitching and visible tread; catalog campaign camera. No logos, tag, pair or floor.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
